text:
Ni the time that to the pasar me repetía

que no tendría fin my desventura

será capaz with its palabra oscura

de resistir the light of my alegría,


ni the espacio that a day and otro día

convertía distancia in amargura

me apartará of the persona pura

que itself confunde with my poesía.


Porque to the Amor that itself prolonga

por encima of cada sepultura

no existe time where the sun itself ponga.


Porque to the Amor omnipotente,

que everything lo transforma and transfigura,

no existe espacio that no esté presente.

translation.title: Soneto of the love victorioso
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
